result.rationale: Candidate A invents an ambiguity ('KM-6 does not establish whether or under what conditions W4 batches envelopes for 12 seconds') that is not present in the source. The source states W4 *may* batch envelopes for 12 s — the 'may' qualifier already encodes the conditionality; no additional ambiguity about batching conditions is present in the source material. Criterion 3 explicitly says 'without inventing ambiguity'. This is a consequential violation affecting candidate A. Candidate B correctly reports 'none' for AMBIGUITIES, preserves all required elements (G7-to-Q2 relation, W4 batching role, 'may' qualifier, 12 s, KM-6 provenance, exact quotation, missing baseline as evidence limitation, attributed claim not promoted to system fact), and satisfies all four criteria.
